# Configuration

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs/env-table.ts from the variables read in packages/*/src. Do not edit by hand:
     change the DOCS table in the script and run `node scripts/docs/env-table.ts`. CI runs it with --check. -->

Every environment variable the server reads (86). Unset means the feature is off unless the default says
otherwise. Flags accept `1`, `on`, `true` or `yes`. The production profile's requirements are in
[DEPLOY.md](DEPLOY.md) §5; the release process's own variables are in [RELEASE.md](RELEASE.md).

| Variable | Default | Meaning | Read in (`packages/`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ALLOW_CLEAR_SIGNING_KEYS` | off | With `DATABASE_URL` and no `SIGNING_KEY_SEAL`, allows the signing keyring to be stored in clear in `gate_doc`; otherwise the start is refused. Refused by the production profile. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `ALLOW_DEMO_WORLD` | off | Production profile: allows the first start to seed from a world whose `world.json` is marked `"demo": true` (the image's toy world). Local test deployments only; otherwise production refuses to seed fictional people. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `ANCHOR_INTERVAL` | 3600 | Seconds between RFC 3161 anchors of the audit head (with `TSA_URL`); at least 60. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `AUDIT_CHECKPOINT_MIGRATE` | unset | File mode, one-time: the reviewed head hash of an older audit chain that has no keyed checkpoint yet. Its first start with `SIGNING_KEY_SEAL` authenticates exactly that head and audits `checkpoint_migrated`; any other head (a rewritten chain, or the same chain once it grew) is refused, so a deleted checkpoint is never re-minted. Remove it afterwards (docs/DEPLOY.md). | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS` | unset (keep all rows) | Audit rows older than this many days (1..36500) are sealed as an authenticated segment before their prefix is removed. Requires `SIGNING_KEY_SEAL`. File mode runs at start and daily; PostgreSQL runs only through `scripts/ops/audit-retention.ts` as the owner with every writer stopped. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `BLP_SESSIONS_PER_CREDENTIAL` | 10000 | Concurrently open PDP-issued session tokens per PEP credential over all its subjects, 1..100000. Opening above the cap gets 409 `session_limit` (audited `credential_session_cap`), so distinct subject ids cannot each take a `BLP_SESSIONS_PER_SUBJECT` share; cluster-wide with PostgreSQL (docs/API.md §2). | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `BLP_SESSIONS_PER_PEP` | 10000 | Session high-water marks one PEP credential may hold at once (1..100000). A credential at its share gets `BLP.SESSION_LIMIT` on a read that would open a new mark (without a database; with one, its own oldest cached mark makes room), while other credentials keep theirs; 100,000 marks over all credentials stay the overall bound (docs/API.md §2). | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `BLP_SESSIONS_PER_SUBJECT` | 4 | Concurrently open PDP-issued session tokens per (PEP credential, subject), 1..1000. Opening above the cap gets 409 `session_limit`; every open token of the pair shares one high-water mark, and close does not clear it (docs/API.md §2). | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `BLP_SESSION_CREATION_PER_MINUTE` | 60 | Session-creation requests a minute per PEP credential, a separate token bucket with 429 and Retry-After (open and cap refusals are audited). Cluster mode leases from PostgreSQL; a replica also charges its local budget before forwarding (docs/API.md §2). | `pdp-http/src/ratelimit.ts` |
| `BLP_SESSION_REQUIRED` | off | Every read above L0, and every write by a subject cleared above L0, needs a session (else `BLP.SESSION_REQUIRED`). Production requires this and accepts only `context.sessionToken` from `POST /x/v1/sessions`; raw `sessionId` is refused. Demo keeps raw ids as a warned compatibility mode (docs/API.md §2). | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `BREAK_GLASS_WEBHOOK` | unset (no notices) | https URL that receives signed break-glass notices; set together with `BREAK_GLASS_WEBHOOK_SECRET`. No query string, no credentials. | `pdp-http/src/notify.ts` |
| `BREAK_GLASS_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | unset | HMAC secret for break-glass notices, at least 32 characters. | `pdp-http/src/notify.ts` |
| `CLOCK` | unset (system clock) | `fixed:<ISO timestamp>` pins the time for demos. Refused by the production profile. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `DATABASE_TLS` | `verify-full` in production, `require` otherwise | PostgreSQL transport policy. `verify-full` checks the server certificate chain and hostname and is required for a non-local host in production. `require` encrypts without authenticating the server. `disable` is allowed only outside production or for loopback/unix-socket hosts. `verify-full` cannot be used with a unix socket. | `pdp-http/src/postgres-tls.ts` |
| `DATABASE_TLS_CA_FILE` | unset (system CA store) | PEM CA bundle for `DATABASE_TLS=verify-full`, for a private PostgreSQL CA. The server certificate must also name the `DATABASE_URL` host. | `pdp-http/src/postgres-tls.ts` |
| `DATABASE_TLS_CERT_FILE` | unset | Optional PEM PostgreSQL client certificate; set together with `DATABASE_TLS_KEY_FILE`. Not valid with `DATABASE_TLS=disable`. | `pdp-http/src/postgres-tls.ts` |
| `DATABASE_TLS_KEY_FILE` | unset | PEM private key for `DATABASE_TLS_CERT_FILE`; set together. Not valid with `DATABASE_TLS=disable`. | `pdp-http/src/postgres-tls.ts` |
| `DATABASE_URL` | unset (local files, one node) | PostgreSQL connection string: state, audit and shared security material; one active node and standbys, or several deciding nodes with `GATE_CLUSTER`. Do not put `ssl`/`sslmode` or TLS file parameters in it: `DATABASE_TLS` is the only TLS policy. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `DATA_DIR` | `data/runtime` | Directory for local state, audit, keys and `INITIAL-CREDENTIALS.txt`. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `DEMO_ALLOW_REMOTE` | off | Demo profile only: lets it listen on a non-loopback `HOST` (it refuses to start otherwise) and prints a warning at start. The demo has seeded accounts, a toy world and the production checks off; `/metrics` still needs `METRICS_TOKEN` there. Ignored by the production profile. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `GATE_ADVERTISE_URL` | unset | Cluster mode: this node's internal address, an http(s) origin (no credentials, path, query or fragment; anything else stops the process at start), published in PostgreSQL while it leads. Followers forward `/admin/`, `/scim/` and `/x/v1/resources` requests to it with a signed hop (needs `SIGNING_KEY_SEAL`; docs/API.md §3.9.1), and name it in their `409 not_leader` answers when they cannot forward. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `GATE_CLUSTER` | off | With `DATABASE_URL`: every node decides against the shared PostgreSQL, the admin plane, SCIM and resource registration stay on the leader (followers forward them to `GATE_ADVERTISE_URL`, or answer `409 not_leader`; `GET /leaderz` is 200 only on the leader), followers follow changes by LISTEN/NOTIFY (docs/API.md §3.9.1). Each node needs its own `GATE_NODE_ID`. Ignored without `DATABASE_URL`. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `GATE_MAX_STALENESS_MS` | 2000 | Cluster mode and replicas: a node that last confirmed the shared state longer ago refuses decisions (503) and fails `/readyz`; integer in 100..60000. A replica polls its feed every quarter of it. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `GATE_NODE_ID` | `0` | With PostgreSQL, the audit chain this node writes: 1..64 characters from `[A-Za-z0-9_.-]`, starting with a letter or digit. Unique per node in cluster mode (a second process with the same id waits). `0` is the chain of earlier versions. A replica (`GATE_REPLICA_OF`) must set it (not `0`): it names its own chain on the database; one whose disk was lost starts with a new id. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `GATE_PROFILE` | `demo` | `demo` or `production`; production refuses to start unless every check of docs/DEPLOY.md §5 holds. Any other value stops the process. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `GATE_REPLICA_AUDIT_LAG_MS` | 10000 | Replica: it refuses decisions (503, `/readyz` 503) while a durable local audit row has waited longer than this to be stored by the database; the bound on what a lost replica disk can lose. Integer in 100..3600000. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `GATE_REPLICA_CA_FILE` | unset (system CA store) | Replica: PEM CA that verifies the database nodes' TLS certificate (`GATE_REPLICA_OF`), for the feed, the JWKS bootstrap, audit shipping and forwarded requests. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `GATE_REPLICA_KEY` | none (required with `GATE_REPLICA_OF`) | Replica: its secret, 32 bytes as base64url or hex, as listed for its id in the database nodes' `GATE_REPLICA_KEYS`. HKDF derives the hop key (every request), the audit key (row MACs and the checkpoint) and the key of `replica-trust.json`. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `GATE_REPLICA_KEYS` | unset (no replicas served) | Database node: the replicas it serves the signed state feed and audit ingestion, `id=key,id=key` (keys as in `GATE_REPLICA_KEY`); `prefix*=master` is a group: each id holds only HKDF(master, its id), from `scripts/ops/replica-key.ts`. Needs `DATABASE_URL` (docs/API.md §3.9.5). | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `GATE_REPLICA_KEY_FILE` | unset | Replica: a file holding `GATE_REPLICA_KEY` (used when that is unset); the k8s component writes the pod's own key there. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `GATE_REPLICA_OF` | unset (not a replica) | This node is a stateless decision replica of the database nodes at this origin (https; plain http only on loopback): no `DATABASE_URL`, its own durable audit chain in `DATA_DIR`, everything it may not decide forwarded (docs/API.md §3.9.5). | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `GATE_REPLICA_PIN` | unset (trust the JWKS over verified TLS) | Replica, first start only: comma-separated Ed25519 public keys (the `x` of `/.well-known/jwks.json` entries) the first snapshot must be signed by. Later rotations are followed through the introduction the old key signs; the trusted set and the rollback floor persist in `DATA_DIR/replica-trust.json` (MAC under `GATE_REPLICA_KEY`). | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `GATE_SERVE_TENANTS` | all manifest tenants | Comma-separated distinct tenant ids in GATE_TENANTS_FILE. Lowercase letter followed by up to 62 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens. Empty, duplicate and unknown ids refuse startup. Other tenants receive HTTP 421 tenant_not_served. | `pdp-http/src/tenants.ts` |
| `GATE_TENANTS_FILE` | unset (single tenant) | JSON tenant map for isolated runtimes: each entry needs dataDir and worldDir; database tenants need separate databaseUrl and signingKeySeal. Optional signingKeySealPrevious, auditCheckpointMigration, replicaOf, replicaKey, replicaPins, replicaKeys, replicaCaFile, advertiseUrl, publicOrigin. Secret file, mode 600. Requests require X-Qadamar-Tenant (docs/DEPLOY.md). Only selected runtimes are opened. | `pdp-http/src/tenants.ts` |
| `HOST` | `127.0.0.1` | Listen address. The demo profile refuses a non-loopback address (anything but `localhost`, `127.0.0.0/8`, `::1`) unless `DEMO_ALLOW_REMOTE` is on. On a non-loopback address `/metrics` needs `METRICS_TOKEN` in every profile. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `IMPACT_MAX_EVALUATIONS` | 100000 | Upper bound on affected-cell evaluations in an impact preview or proposal, after network and maker/history variants; positive integer. Read at the first proposal, not at start. | `pdp-http/src/admin/changes.ts` |
| `INITIAL_CREDENTIALS_TTL_SECONDS` | 3600 | Lifetime of the first-start bootstrap credentials; integer in 1..86400. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `METRICS_TOKEN` | unset (`/metrics` open on a loopback address, 403 on any other) | Bearer token required on `GET /metrics`; the production profile requires at least 32 characters. | `pdp-http/src/metrics.ts`, `pdp-http/src/profile.ts` |
| `OIDC_ACR` | unset | When set, sent as `acr_values` and the ID token's `acr` must equal it; otherwise `amr` must show MFA. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `OIDC_CLIENT_ID` | none (required with `OIDC_ISSUER`) | OIDC client id of the console. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET` | unset | OIDC client secret, for a confidential client. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `OIDC_ID_CLAIM` | none (required with `OIDC_ISSUER`) | ID token claim that carries the subject id your applications use (`email` also needs `email_verified`). | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `OIDC_ISSUER` | unset (local password accounts) | OIDC issuer for console sign-in (https, or http on loopback); needs `PUBLIC_ORIGIN`. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `OIDC_ROLE_CLAIM` | `roles` | ID token claim that carries the console roles. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `OPENSSL` | `openssl` | OpenSSL binary used to verify timestamp tokens against `TSA_CA_FILE`. | `pdp-http/src/anchor.ts` |
| `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` | unset (no tracing) | OTLP/HTTP JSON trace collector; `/v1/traces` is appended. http(s), no credentials, query or fragment; the production profile accepts plain http only on loopback. | `pdp-http/src/tracing.ts` |
| `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME` | `gate-pdp` | Service name on exported spans. | `pdp-http/src/tracing.ts` |
| `PASSWORD_LOGIN` | on without an IdP, off with OIDC or SAML | Local password sign-in (`1`, `on`, `true`, `yes` turn it on). | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `PEP_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE` | 60000 | Decisions a minute per PEP credential and per client address on the decision plane (`/access/*`, `/x/*`, `/xacml/v3/authorize`); a batch costs one per item. At least 1000, the largest batch. Cluster mode leases capacity from the shared PostgreSQL bucket; a replica keeps local buckets at its share. | `pdp-http/src/ratelimit.ts` |
| `PEP_ROTATION_GRACE_SECONDS` | 300 | Seconds a rotated PEP API key keeps working; integer in 0..86400. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `POLICY_SIGNATURE_ADOPT` | off | Adopts (signs) a stored policy bundle whose signature does not verify, once, after a restore. Refused by the production profile. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `PORT` | 8787 | Listen port, 0..65535. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `PUBLIC_ORIGIN` | unset | External origin (https, or http on loopback) for cookies, HSTS, the OIDC redirect and the SAML endpoints; required with OIDC or SAML. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE` | 120 | Requests a minute per client address and per signed-in principal on the console, SCIM and public routes (token bucket, 429 with Retry-After). Cluster mode leases capacity from the shared PostgreSQL bucket; other modes use one local bucket per node. A replica (`GATE_REPLICA_OF`) keeps local buckets: set its share (docs/API.md §3.9.5). | `pdp-http/src/ratelimit.ts` |
| `RESOURCE_OWNERS` | unset | JSON object: console user id -> array of resource owner ids it answers for (demo: `{"ruth":["carol"]}`). | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `RESOURCE_PENDING_PROPOSALS_PER_PEP` | 100 | Resource registration: `register_resources` changes one PEP credential may have awaiting review at once; a call that would queue another is refused with `409 proposal_limit` (docs/API.md §2.2). Positive integer. | `pdp-http/src/resources.ts` |
| `SAML_ACS_URL` | `PUBLIC_ORIGIN` + `/admin/v1/saml/acs` | Assertion consumer service URL the IdP posts to and the bearer `Recipient` must name (https, path `/admin/v1/saml/acs`). | `pdp-http/src/saml.ts` |
| `SAML_AUTHN_CONTEXT` | none (required with `SAML_IDP_ENTITY_ID`) | Comma-separated `AuthnContextClassRef` values that prove multi-factor authentication at the IdP: requested (exact), and every `AuthnStatement` must carry one, else `mfa_required`. | `pdp-http/src/saml.ts` |
| `SAML_DECRYPTION_CERT_FILE` | unset | Matching PEM certificate for the assertion decryption key; published as the encryption certificate in SP metadata. | `pdp-http/src/saml.ts` |
| `SAML_DECRYPTION_KEY_FILE` | unset | Mounted PEM RSA 2048+ private key for encrypted assertions; requires matching SAML_DECRYPTION_CERT_FILE. Never published or logged. | `pdp-http/src/saml.ts` |
| `SAML_IDP_CERT_FILE` | none (required with `SAML_IDP_ENTITY_ID`) | PEM file with the IdP signing certificate(s), pinned (RSA 2048+ or EC); IdP metadata is never fetched. | `pdp-http/src/saml.ts` |
| `SAML_IDP_ENTITY_ID` | unset (no SAML sign-in) | SAML 2.0 IdP entity id for console sign-in: the `Issuer` every assertion and logout request must carry; needs `PUBLIC_ORIGIN`. | `pdp-http/src/saml.ts` |
| `SAML_IDP_SLO_URL` | unset (local sign-out only) | Pinned IdP SingleLogoutService HTTP-Redirect URL (https or loopback); requires SP signing key and certificate. Enables SP-initiated logout and LogoutResponse replies. | `pdp-http/src/saml.ts` |
| `SAML_IDP_SSO_URL` | none (required with `SAML_IDP_ENTITY_ID`) | IdP SingleSignOnService URL, HTTP-Redirect binding (https, or http on loopback). | `pdp-http/src/saml.ts` |
| `SAML_ID_ATTRIBUTE` | none (required with `SAML_IDP_ENTITY_ID`) | Assertion attribute that carries the subject id your applications use, compared as is; `NameID` uses the subject NameID. | `pdp-http/src/saml.ts` |
| `SAML_MAX_AUTH_AGE_SECONDS` | 43200 (12 h) | Longest time since the IdP authenticated the user (`AuthnInstant` of every `AuthnStatement`), 60..604800 seconds. | `pdp-http/src/saml.ts` |
| `SAML_ROLE_ATTRIBUTE` | `roles` | Assertion attribute that carries the console roles. | `pdp-http/src/saml.ts` |
| `SAML_SIGNING_CERT_FILE` | unset | Matching PEM certificate for the SP signing key; published in SP metadata. | `pdp-http/src/saml.ts` |
| `SAML_SIGNING_KEY_FILE` | unset | Mounted PEM RSA 2048+ private key for outgoing SAML Redirect signatures (SHA-256); requires matching SAML_SIGNING_CERT_FILE. | `pdp-http/src/saml.ts` |
| `SAML_SP_ENTITY_ID` | `PUBLIC_ORIGIN` + `/admin/v1/saml/metadata` | Entity id of the console as a SAML service provider: the audience assertions must name. | `pdp-http/src/saml.ts` |
| `SCIM_BEARER_TOKEN` | unset | Bearer credential for `/scim/v2` (32..256 characters), set from the environment instead of minted in the console. | `pdp-http/src/scim.ts` |
| `SCIM_DIRECT` | off | Applies SCIM changes directly instead of as two-person changes; requires `SCIM_BEARER_TOKEN`. | `pdp-http/src/scim.ts` |
| `SCIM_GROUP_ROLES` | unset | JSON object: SCIM group name -> PDP role, one group per role. | `pdp-http/src/scim.ts` |
| `SIEM_BATCH_SIZE` | 100 | Audit rows per SIEM push; 1..1000. | `pdp-http/src/siem.ts` |
| `SIEM_HMAC_SECRET` | unset | HMAC secret for SIEM pushes, at least 32 characters; set together with `SIEM_WEBHOOK_URL`. | `pdp-http/src/siem.ts` |
| `SIEM_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | 30 | Seconds between SIEM pushes; 1..86400. | `pdp-http/src/siem.ts` |
| `SIEM_WEBHOOK_URL` | unset (no push export) | https receiver of the audit push export. | `pdp-http/src/siem.ts` |
| `SIGNING_KEY_SEAL` | unset | 32 bytes as base64url or 64 hex characters: seals the signing keyring and TOTP secrets, keys the audit checkpoint HMAC. Required with PostgreSQL (unless `ALLOW_CLEAR_SIGNING_KEYS`), for TOTP, and by the production profile. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `SIGNING_KEY_SEAL_PREVIOUS` | unset | Seal key rotation only: the old `SIGNING_KEY_SEAL`, set together with the new one. The start re-seals under the new key everything only the old one opens (signing keyring, TOTP secrets, audit checkpoint) and audits `seal_key_rotated`; remove it afterwards. A start where a sealed value opens under neither key is refused and changes nothing (docs/handbook/operations/rotate-credentials.md). | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `SOD_HISTORY` | `server` | `server` ignores caller-supplied maker and history for SoD-constrained actions in every profile. `caller` is an explicit compatibility opt-in for demos/tests and logs a warning; production refuses it. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `TLS_CERT_FILE` | unset | PEM certificate; with `TLS_KEY_FILE` the node serves https itself. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `TLS_KEY_FILE` | unset | PEM private key for `TLS_CERT_FILE`. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `TRUSTED_PROXIES` | unset (no proxy trusted) | Comma-separated addresses or CIDR ranges of the reverse proxies in front of the node. Only from such a peer is the client address read from `X-Forwarded-For` (its rightmost untrusted entry), for the per-IP rate limit, login lockout, sign-in audit rows and request spans. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `TSA_CA_FILE` | unset | CA file the timestamp tokens are verified against (OpenSSL). Required by the production profile. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `TSA_URL` | unset (no anchoring) | RFC 3161 timestamp authority for the audit head. The production profile requires https. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |
| `WORLD_DIR` | `examples/toy-domain` | Seed `bundle.json` and `world.json`, read only when no stored state exists yet (first start). The production profile refuses a world marked `"demo": true` (the shipped examples) unless `ALLOW_DEMO_WORLD` is on. | `pdp-http/src/main.ts` |

## Operations scripts

Backup and restore (`scripts/ops`, docs/DEPLOY.md §4; the managed offer passes them from Secrets, docs/MANAGED-OFFER.md) (14).

| Variable | Default | Meaning | Read in (`scripts/ops/`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS` | none (required by audit-retention.ts) | `audit-retention.ts`: expired-prefix age in days, 1..36500. Stop every Qadamar writer and use the owner role; the service role is never granted audit DELETE. | `audit-retention.ts` |
| `BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY` | none (required) | AES-256-GCM key of the backup archives, 32 bytes as 64 hex characters or unpadded base64url. `backup.sh` encrypts and `restore.sh` refuses an archive that does not authenticate under it. Keep it apart from the archives and from the database. | `archive-crypt.ts`, `backup.sh`, `restore.sh` |
| `BACKUP_FILE` | none (required) | Archive path: written by `backup.sh` (never overwritten), read by `restore.sh`. | `backup.sh`, `restore.sh` |
| `DATABASE_TLS` | `verify-full`, `require` with `GATE_PROFILE=demo` | PostgreSQL TLS policy of `database-tls.ts`, `migrate-records.ts` and `audit-retention.ts`, exported as libpq settings by `backup.sh` and `restore.sh`. Production requires `verify-full` for every non-local target or maintenance host. | `database-tls.ts` |
| `DATABASE_TLS_CA_FILE` | unset (system CA store) | PEM CA bundle for `DATABASE_TLS=verify-full`; maps to `PGSSLROOTCERT` (`system` when unset, which needs libpq 16 or later; the ops image has 17). | `database-tls.ts` |
| `DATABASE_TLS_CERT_FILE` | unset | Optional PEM PostgreSQL client certificate for the operations tools; set with `DATABASE_TLS_KEY_FILE`. | `database-tls.ts` |
| `DATABASE_TLS_KEY_FILE` | unset | PEM private key for `DATABASE_TLS_CERT_FILE`; set together. | `database-tls.ts` |
| `DATABASE_URL` | none (required) | `backup.sh`: the database to dump (a role that bypasses RLS); `restore.sh`: the NEW database to create and restore into (the owner role). TLS URL parameters are refused; use `DATABASE_TLS`. | `audit-retention.ts`, `backup.sh`, `database-tls.ts`, `migrate-records.ts`, `restore.sh` |
| `GATE_PROFILE` | `production` | Operations database tools default to `production` (`verify-full`, and any weaker policy refused for a non-local database) unless `GATE_PROFILE=demo` is set explicitly. | `audit-retention.ts`, `database-tls.ts`, `migrate-records.ts` |
| `MAINTENANCE_DATABASE_URL` | the target URL with database `postgres` | `restore.sh`: the database to connect to while creating (or removing after a failure) the target. | `database-tls.ts`, `restore.sh` |
| `SIGNING_KEY_SEAL` | none (required by audit-retention.ts) | `audit-retention.ts`: the deployment seal, used only through the HKDF-derived audit checkpoint key to authenticate new segment seals. | `audit-retention.ts` |
| `SIGNING_KEY_SEAL_PREVIOUS` | unset | `audit-retention.ts`: previous deployment seal during rotation; old segment HMACs are verified and re-keyed by the owner before nodes restart with only the new seal. | `audit-retention.ts` |
| `TSA_CA_FILE` | unset | `audit-retention.ts`: CA bundle used to verify the RFC 3161 anchor of the sealed heads when `TSA_URL` is set. | `audit-retention.ts` |
| `TSA_URL` | unset (HMAC only) | `audit-retention.ts`: RFC 3161 authority that timestamps the sealed heads before any audit prefix is deleted. | `audit-retention.ts` |

Not read by the server or the operations scripts, used by tests and tools only: `TEST_DATABASE_URL` and
`PG_TOOLS_CONTAINER` (live PostgreSQL tests, docs/QUALITY.md), `BACKUP_TESTS_REQUIRED=1` (fail rather than skip
backup drills without client tools; set by CI when `PG_TOOLS_CONTAINER` is present), `FUZZ_SEED` and `FUZZ_RUNS`
(`packages/core/test/fuzz.test.ts`), `IMPACT_FUZZ_RUNS` (`packages/pdp-http/test/impact.test.ts`),
`E2E_REQUIRED` (missing Chromium is fatal), `PLAYWRIGHT_CORE_PATH` / `PLAYWRIGHT_CORE` (local browser driver),
`PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH` (browser cache) and `CI_CHROMIUM_SHA256` (CI browser archive pin, docs/CI.md),
`PDP_URL` (console dev server proxy, `apps/admin/vite.config.ts`),
`GATE_K8S_TEST` and `GATE_K8S_CONTEXT` (`packages/pdp-http/test/k8s.test.ts`).
